scenario: I work as a receptionist in a five-star hotel in Manhattan. My duties include checking in guests, answering calls, as well as monitoring the lobby and elevator security cameras. On a slow night, I was staring at the camera livestreams on the computer and saw a well-known celebrity couple enter. Everything seemed normal until the couple got in a heated argument, leading to a physical altercation, where one party was overpowered by the other. When they got to the ground floor, the victim walked out of the elevator looking shaken but unharmed, and both parties immediately went their separate ways. Our hotel prides itself on privacy and security, which is why many renowned people stay here. The hotel recording policy strictly forbids employees from sharing any recordings for any reason. If I leak the footage online, the altercation will be reported and the perpetrator will be punished. If I do not do this, the altercation will go unreported and the perpetrator unpunished.
entities: I,the celebrity who was overpowered in the altercation,the celebrity who overpowered the other in the altercation
outcomes: The altercation is not reported by me
The perpetrator faces no immediate punishment from my decision
The victim receives no immediate help from me
The celebrity couple's privacy is preserved
I remain in compliance with hotel policy
I avoid immediate job-related consequences for leaking footage
